summary: Reduce indexed Web history retraction replay retention and bound explicit legacy view maintenance.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing EventStore and SessionStore history read views.
components.disposition: Indexed Web pages with retractable user rows scan canonical JSONL for exact retraction events; ASCII literal or Unicode-escaped type candidates use existing parser. Keep stable full-source-stamp cache of at most 16 sessions and 1MiB serialized retained retractions; no truncation of returned facts, unstable sources not cached, exceptions fall back to existing full replay. Full load/model path unchanged. Explicit batch maintenance of at most 8 selected session IDs, 64MiB default/128MiB hard source-read budget, one parse per session, existing identity and management lease, no canonical writes. CLI plan-only by default, explicit roots and apply. No Web-triggered backfill.
evidence: 207 targeted Python tests passed, Ruff/Pyright and diff checks passed; CLI plan/apply synthetic smoke preserved source bytes and stamp.

Five fresh-process alternating synthetic runs: 10,000 events, 42,379,640 bytes, two retractions; full cold median 48.056ms vs selective 48.364ms, warm 0.101 vs 0.016ms, peak RSS 79.203 vs 22.562MiB, retained events 10000 vs 2. OS cache not cleared; no production latency claim.

Unicode escaped type, unrelated payload mention, malformed candidate, same-size replacement, cross-process append, old segment change, deletion, unstable stamp, cache budgets, indexed exact retraction, active run skip, identity conflict, source budget and exact source preservation tested.
components.verification_level: Local targeted and synthetic measurements only; independent review, original R9, CI, production/device acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto if selective read misses an exact retraction, caches a changed source, permits identity adoption, bypasses active Run lease, rewrites canonical data or claims a complete audit. Cold scan remains proportional to event source bytes; no hard RSS claim or new authority. Large page fallback and production legacy backfill remain explicit.
components.rollback_route: Revert code; canonical session/event sources unchanged. Existing full read and individual derived index rebuild remain available.
